g1.flow: Both say wa aṭīʿu llāha wa aṭīʿu r-rasūl and end ʿalā rasūlina l-balāghu l-mubīn. Al-Māʾidah, right after Satan's intoxicants and gambling, adds wa ḥdharū (and beware), then fa-ʿlamū annamā (then know). At-Taghābun, after 'no disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh', has neither: just fa-innamā. Hook: 'beware' sits beside the warning about Satan; At-Taghābun is the plain one.

cues.5:92: After intoxicants and gambling, 'will you not desist?'; adds wa ḥdharū and fa-ʿlamū annamā.
cues.64:12: After 'no disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh'; no 'beware', just fa-innamā.
